enabled.description: Whether to enable the ejabberd_mod_message_log module.

logpath.description: Absolute path to the file where message log entries are written.

max_days.description: Maximum number of days to retain log entries. Set to 0 to keep logs indefinitely.

format.description: Log format: plain text ('text') or JSON ('json'). JSON is recommended for ingestion by log analysis tools.

domains.description: List of VirtualHost domains for which to log messages. Empty list logs all domains.
